title: Harvesting Baby Green Spinach in Containers
reason: The video describes the process of harvesting and growing baby green spinach in containers.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the method of harvesting baby green spinach.

subtasks.text: Show how to cut the spinach from the outside and work your way inward.
Demonstrate the quicker method of cutting the spinach right off at the top.

tasks.task: Explain the benefits of retaining a base for reharvesting.

subtasks.text: Highlight the importance of leaving a base in the container.
Note that cutting near the base allows for multiple harvests.

tasks.task: Show the use of a screen cover to grow spinach in summer.

subtasks.text: Present the screen cover and how it's positioned over the container.
Explain the shading provided by the screen cover.
Describe the benefits of using the screen cover in summer.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the growth and harvesting of spinach with the screen cover.

subtasks.text: Show the container with morning sun only.
Highlight the use of the screen to prevent insect damage.
Demonstrate the abundant spinach harvest after using the screen cover.
